name: Cloud Street
area: PT Road (Poet Tyagaraja Road), opposite Government Hospital
signature_dish: Wood-fired pizza with house cakes for dessert
why_it_matters: Kodaikanal's best-loved pizza-and-cake address — a rustic first-floor room on PT Road with retro decor and weekend live music. The wood-fired pizzas and divine house cakes have made it a fixture on every Kodai dining list.
insider_tip: First floor, opposite the Government Hospital on PT Road — easy to miss at street level. Come on a weekend evening for the live music, and save room for the cakes. Book ahead in the April-June peak.
signature_address: Cloud Street, 1st Floor, PT Road, opposite Government Hospital, Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu 624101

name: Bistro 1845
signature_dish: Wood-fired pizza and lal maas by the fireplace
why_it_matters: Currently Kodaikanal's top-ranked restaurant on Tripadvisor (4.9/5, 200+ reviews) — a bistro with indoor fireside dining and outdoor seating that reviewers rate as fine-dining quality at reasonable prices. The pizza, lal maas and grilled fish are the dishes people return for.
insider_tip: Ask for an indoor table near the fireplace once the evening cold sets in. Strong on continental and North Indian alike; book ahead on weekends and through the summer peak.
signature_address: Bistro 1845, Kodaikanal town centre, Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu 624101

name: Astoria Veg Restaurant
why_it_matters: The busy pure-veg restaurant of Hotel Astoria on Anna Salai (Bazaar Road) — Kodaikanal's most central and reliable address for an everyday South Indian thali and tiffin. The default lunch stop for families staying near the bazaar.
insider_tip: Right on Anna Salai in the heart of the bazaar — handy between the lake and the shops. Pure-veg and quick; the unlimited South Indian thali at lunch is the value pick. Expect a queue at peak season.
signature_address: Astoria Veg Restaurant, Hotel Astoria, Anna Salai, Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu 624101

name: Tava Vegetarian Restaurant
signature_dish: Masala dosa and paneer butter masala in a simple veg dining room
why_it_matters: A popular pure-veg restaurant in the Satya Complex on PT Road, serving both South and North Indian food — a dependable, well-priced sit-down option in central Kodaikanal favoured by locals and tourists alike.
insider_tip: Right on PT Road near the cluster of cafes — good for a fuller veg meal when you want a thali or North Indian curry rather than just snacks. Masala dosa and paneer butter masala are the orders.
signature_address: Tava Vegetarian Restaurant, Satya Complex, PT Road, Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu 624101

name: Daily Bread Pastry Corner
signature_dish: Old-school cream buns, pastries and milky filter coffee
why_it_matters: A Kodaikanal bakery institution on Bazaar Road with a 30-year legacy — old-school pastries, cream buns, white-bread chutney and egg sandwiches and a famously milky-sweet filter coffee. The kind of long-running bakery that locals grew up on.
insider_tip: Go for the old-school cream buns and the sweet filter coffee — this is nostalgia baking, not a modern patisserie. Also a good place to pick up Kodaikanal's hand-made chocolates and homemade jams.
signature_address: Daily Bread Pastry Corner, Anna Salai, Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu 624101

name: Altaf's Cafe
signature_dish: Hummus and falafel platters in the Vattakanal backpacker enclave
why_it_matters: The best-known cafe in Vattakanal — the laid-back backpacker hamlet on Dolphin's Nose Road below Kodaikanal — serving Lebanese and Mediterranean food. With thousands of reviews, it is the anchor of Vattakanal's traveller cafe scene.
insider_tip: Vattakanal is a separate hamlet ~5km below Kodaikanal town toward Dolphin's Nose — plan it around the cliff walk. Open 9.30am-9pm; the hummus-falafel platters and views over the valley are the draw.
signature_address: Altaf's Cafe, Dolphin's Nose Road, Vattakanal, Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu 624101

name: The Royal Tibet
why_it_matters: A long-running small Tibetan eatery that reviewers call 'the mecca of Tibetan food in Kodai' — the town's go-to for momos and thukpa, served hot and authentic in a cramped, always-busy room.
insider_tip: Tiny and popular, so expect close quarters and a wait at peak times. Order the steamed momos and a bowl of thukpa on a cold evening — that's what it does best.
signature_address: The Royal Tibet, Kodaikanal town centre, Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu 624101
